summary: Audited all 28 recipes against live code. Deleted 3 obsolete (874 lines) incl. two documenting a Python arrow module deleted in commit e98301b. Fixed the click-through/mouseenter trap. Anchored all 25 survivors with verified exemplar paths. Found 3 actively-wrong dwell timings baked into templates (DWELL_TIME 600 vs real 250-300) and replaced every tunable with its constant name; added a RECIPE VALUES check to check-docs.js so it cannot regress.
